From 11/18 08:00 to 11/22 02:00, the US model, the only model with visibility data, shows visibility between 38 m and 194 m, below the 1000 m threshold, resulting in a Medium vote for dense fog. In all other periods, as well as for wind and rain across all models, the risk is Low, and the European ensemble shows a 0% chance of gusts over 29 kt.
